question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Let sleeping dogs lie

options.text: Leave an existing situation as it is

solution:
The correct answer is: Leave an existing situation as it is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Let sleeping dogs lie"** means to avoid interfering in a situation that is currently causing no problems but might do so as a result of such interference; it's better to leave things as they are. (चीजों को जैसा है वैसा ही रहने देना)

 
 
• **Example: **Even though I know I could probably get a refund if I complained about the minor scratch on the new phone, I've decided to let sleeping dogs lie.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Leave an existing situation as it is.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To let somebody sleep **(किसी को सोने देना): Literally allowing someone to rest without disturbance.

 
 
• **Example:** After the long journey, they decided to let their children sleep till late in the morning.
 
 
 
• **To fall sick intentionally **(जानबूझकर बीमार पड़ना): To pretend to be ill in order to avoid duty or work.
 
 
• **Example: **He didn't want to attend the meeting, so he decided to fall sick intentionally.
 
 
 
• **To care for the pet** (पालतू जानवर की देखभाल करना): Taking responsibility for the health and welfare of a pet.
 
 
• **Example:** She spends a lot of time caring for her pets, making sure they are happy and healthy.
